```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ==========================================================
## ROI size analysis with mixed-effects modeling
## ==========================================================
## Purpose:
##   Analyse whether fused-region / ROI area is associated with AP-axis
##   position and whether this relationship differs between genotypes, while
##   accounting for non-independence of multiple ROIs measured from the same fish.
##
## Expected input columns:
##   fishID, genotype, Area number, Area, AP_axis
##
## Main model:
##   Area ~ genotype * AP_axis_scaled + (1 | fishID)
##
## Main outputs:
##   Results/Figures/
##   Results/Statistics/
##   Results/QC/
## ==========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readxl)
  library(lme4)
  library(lmerTest)
  library(emmeans)
})

## -----------------------------
## User settings
## -----------------------------

input_file <- "fusion-human-resq.xlsx"
input_sheet <- 1

results_dir <- "Results"
fig_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "Figures")
stats_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "Statistics")
qc_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "QC")

dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(stats_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(qc_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

genotype_levels <- c("2_het", "3_mut")

genotype_labels <- c(
  "2_het" = "abcc6a+/-",
  "3_mut" = "abcc6a-/-"
)

genotype_cols <- c(
  "2_het" = "#261A68",
  "3_mut" = "#B61515"
)

## Binning setting for optional AP-axis summary
bin_width <- 100

## Smoothing parameter for the descriptive LOESS visualization.
## Larger values produce a smoother curve; smaller values follow local variation
## more closely. This does not affect the mixed-effects model or its statistics.
loess_span <- 0.75

## -----------------------------
## Helper functions
## -----------------------------

format_p_stars <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "n.c.",
    p < 0.0001 ~ "****",
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  )
}

format_p_value <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ NA_character_,
    p < 0.0001 ~ "<0.0001",
    TRUE ~ formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 4)
  )
}

as_numeric_clean <- function(x) {
  as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(x)))
}

write_session_info <- function(path) {
  sink(path)
  print(sessionInfo())
  sink()
}

export_csv <- function(x, filename) {
  readr::write_csv(x, file.path(stats_dir, filename))
}

scamp_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
```

# 1. Load and clean data

```{r load-data}
raw_dat <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = input_sheet)

required_cols <- c("fishID", "genotype", "Area number", "Area", "AP_axis")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(raw_dat))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required column(s): ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

resq_df <- raw_dat %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    fishID = factor(fishID),
    genotype_raw = as.character(genotype),
    genotype = factor(genotype_raw, levels = genotype_levels),
    genotype_label = factor(
      genotype_labels[as.character(genotype)],
      levels = unname(genotype_labels)
    ),
    area_number = factor(`Area number`),
    Area = as_numeric_clean(Area),
    AP_axis = as_numeric_clean(AP_axis)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(fishID),
    !is.na(genotype),
    is.finite(Area),
    is.finite(AP_axis)
  )

if (nrow(resq_df) == 0) {
  stop("No usable rows remained after filtering. Check genotype labels and numeric columns.")
}

## Scale AP-axis for stable mixed-model fitting while keeping raw AP_axis for plotting.
ap_axis_center <- mean(resq_df$AP_axis, na.rm = TRUE)
ap_axis_scale <- sd(resq_df$AP_axis, na.rm = TRUE)

if (!is.finite(ap_axis_scale) || ap_axis_scale == 0) {
  stop("AP_axis has zero or invalid standard deviation; mixed model cannot be fitted.")
}

resq_df <- resq_df %>%
  mutate(
    AP_axis_scaled = (AP_axis - ap_axis_center) / ap_axis_scale
  )

export_csv(
  resq_df,
  "ROI_cleaned_input_data.csv"
)

resq_df
```

# 2. Sample overview

```{r sample-overview}
region_summary <- resq_df %>%
  group_by(genotype, genotype_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_regions = n(),
    n_fish = n_distinct(fishID),
    mean_regions_per_fish = n_regions / n_fish,
    mean_area = mean(Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_area = median(Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_area = sd(Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_area = min(Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_area = max(Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_AP_axis = mean(AP_axis, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_AP_axis = min(AP_axis, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_AP_axis = max(AP_axis, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fish_summary <- resq_df %>%
  group_by(fishID, genotype, genotype_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_regions = n(),
    mean_area = mean(Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_area = median(Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_area = sum(Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_AP_axis = mean(AP_axis, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

export_csv(region_summary, "ROI_region_level_summary_by_genotype.csv")
export_csv(fish_summary, "ROI_fish_level_summary.csv")

region_summary
fish_summary
```

# 3. Mixed-effects model

Multiple ROIs may originate from the same fish. Therefore, ROI-level measurements are analysed using a linear mixed-effects model with fish identity as a random intercept. This accounts for within-fish clustering and avoids treating all ROIs as fully independent observations.

```{r mixed-model}
roi_lmer <- lmerTest::lmer(
  Area ~ genotype * AP_axis_scaled + (1 | fishID),
  data = resq_df,
  REML = FALSE
)

model_formula <- tibble(
  model = "Area ~ genotype * AP_axis_scaled + (1 | fishID)",
  note = "AP_axis was scaled before model fitting; fishID was included as a random intercept."
)

export_csv(model_formula, "ROI_mixed_model_formula.csv")

roi_lmer
```

# 4. Mixed-model statistics

```{r mixed-model-statistics}
## Type III ANOVA table from lmerTest. This tests the genotype effect,
## the AP-axis effect, and their interaction while accounting for fishID.
lmer_anova <- as.data.frame(anova(roi_lmer, type = 3)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = format_p_stars(`Pr(>F)`),
    p_formatted = format_p_value(`Pr(>F)`)
  )

## Fixed-effect coefficient table without broom.mixed.
coef_table <- as.data.frame(summary(roi_lmer)$coefficients) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  as_tibble()

names(coef_table)[names(coef_table) == "Estimate"] <- "estimate"
names(coef_table)[names(coef_table) == "Std. Error"] <- "std_error"
names(coef_table)[names(coef_table) == "df"] <- "df"
names(coef_table)[names(coef_table) == "t value"] <- "t_value"
names(coef_table)[names(coef_table) == "Pr(>|t|)"] <- "p_value"

coef_table <- coef_table %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = format_p_stars(p_value),
    p_formatted = format_p_value(p_value)
  )

## Random-effect variance components.
random_effects <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(roi_lmer)) %>%
  as_tibble()

## Model fit statistics.
model_fit <- tibble(
  AIC = AIC(roi_lmer),
  BIC = BIC(roi_lmer),
  logLik = as.numeric(logLik(roi_lmer)),
  deviance = deviance(roi_lmer),
  n_observations = nobs(roi_lmer),
  n_fish = n_distinct(resq_df$fishID)
)

export_csv(lmer_anova, "ROI_mixed_model_typeIII_ANOVA.csv")
export_csv(coef_table, "ROI_mixed_model_fixed_effects.csv")
export_csv(random_effects, "ROI_mixed_model_random_effects.csv")
export_csv(model_fit, "ROI_mixed_model_fit_statistics.csv")

lmer_anova
coef_table
random_effects
model_fit
```

# 5. Genotype-specific AP-axis slopes

The interaction term tests whether the relationship between ROI area and AP-axis position differs between genotypes. Estimated AP-axis slopes within each genotype and their pairwise comparison are exported below.

```{r emtrends}
ap_trends <- emmeans::emtrends(
  roi_lmer,
  specs = ~ genotype,
  var = "AP_axis_scaled"
)

ap_trends_df <- as.data.frame(
  summary(ap_trends, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    genotype_label = genotype_labels[as.character(genotype)],
    p_label = format_p_stars(p.value),
    p_formatted = format_p_value(p.value)
  )

ap_trend_comparison <- as.data.frame(
  summary(pairs(ap_trends), infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), adjust = "none")
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = format_p_stars(p.value),
    p_formatted = format_p_value(p.value)
  )

export_csv(ap_trends_df, "ROI_estimated_AP_axis_slopes_by_genotype.csv")
export_csv(ap_trend_comparison, "ROI_AP_axis_slope_comparison_between_genotypes.csv")

ap_trends_df
ap_trend_comparison
```

# 6. Mixed-model prediction plot

```{r prediction-data}
pred_grid <- expand.grid(
  AP_axis = seq(
    min(resq_df$AP_axis, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(resq_df$AP_axis, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 200
  ),
  genotype = genotype_levels,
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    genotype = factor(genotype, levels = genotype_levels),
    AP_axis_scaled = (AP_axis - ap_axis_center) / ap_axis_scale
  )

## Fixed-effect prediction and confidence interval calculated manually from
## the model matrix and fixed-effect variance-covariance matrix.
X <- model.matrix(
  ~ genotype * AP_axis_scaled,
  pred_grid
)

beta <- fixef(roi_lmer)
X <- X[, names(beta), drop = FALSE]
V <- as.matrix(vcov(roi_lmer))

pred_grid$fit <- as.numeric(X %*% beta)
pred_grid$se <- sqrt(diag(X %*% V %*% t(X)))
pred_grid <- pred_grid %>%
  mutate(
    lower = fit - 1.96 * se,
    upper = fit + 1.96 * se
  )

export_csv(pred_grid, "ROI_mixed_model_prediction_grid.csv")
```

```{r mixed-model-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
p_mixed_model <- ggplot(
  resq_df,
  aes(
    x = AP_axis,
    y = Area,
    colour = genotype,
    fill = genotype
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.65,
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = pred_grid,
    aes(
      x = AP_axis,
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper,
      fill = genotype
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.18,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = pred_grid,
    aes(
      x = AP_axis,
      y = fit,
      colour = genotype
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = genotype_cols,
    labels = genotype_labels
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = genotype_cols,
    labels = genotype_labels
  ) +
  scamp_theme +
  labs(
    x = "AP-axis position",
    y = "Fused region area",
    title = "Fused region size along the AP axis",
    subtitle = "Linear mixed-effects model: Area ~ genotype × AP-axis + (1 | fishID)",
    colour = "Genotype",
    fill = "Genotype"
  )

p_mixed_model

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "ROI_mixed_model_AP_axis_area.pdf"),
  plot = p_mixed_model,
  width = 10,
  height = 4,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "ROI_mixed_model_AP_axis_area.png"),
  plot = p_mixed_model,
  width = 10,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 600
)
```

# 8. Binned AP-axis visualization

Because AP-axis position is near-continuous, exact-position groups often contain only one observation. For visualization only, AP-axis position is binned. Statistical inference should be based on the mixed-effects model above, not on the binned plot.

```{r binned-summary}
ap_min <- floor(min(resq_df$AP_axis, na.rm = TRUE) / bin_width) * bin_width
ap_max <- ceiling(max(resq_df$AP_axis, na.rm = TRUE) / bin_width) * bin_width + bin_width

resq_binned <- resq_df %>%
  mutate(
    AP_bin = cut(
      AP_axis,
      breaks = seq(ap_min, ap_max, by = bin_width),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = FALSE
    ),
    AP_bin_mid = as.numeric(sub("\\[(.*),(.*)\\)", "\\1", AP_bin)) + bin_width / 2
  )

summary_binned <- resq_binned %>%
  group_by(genotype, genotype_label, AP_bin, AP_bin_mid) %>%
  summarise(
    n_regions = n(),
    n_fish = n_distinct(fishID),
    mean_area = mean(Area, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_area = if_else(n_regions > 1, sd(Area, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    se_area = if_else(n_regions > 1, sd_area / sqrt(n_regions), NA_real_),
    ymin = mean_area - se_area,
    ymax = mean_area + se_area,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

export_csv(
  summary_binned,
  "ROI_binned_AP_axis_summary.csv"
)

summary_binned
```

```{r binned-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
p_binned <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = resq_df,
    aes(
      x = AP_axis,
      y = Area,
      colour = genotype
    ),
    alpha = 0.30,
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = summary_binned,
    aes(
      x = AP_bin_mid,
      y = mean_area,
      colour = genotype,
      group = genotype
    ),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = summary_binned,
    aes(
      x = AP_bin_mid,
      y = mean_area,
      colour = genotype
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_binned %>% filter(!is.na(se_area)),
    aes(
      x = AP_bin_mid,
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      colour = genotype
    ),
    width = bin_width * 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = genotype_cols,
    labels = genotype_labels
  ) +
  scamp_theme +
  labs(
    x = paste0("AP-axis position, binned every ", bin_width, " units"),
    y = "Fused region area",
    title = "Binned fused-region size along the AP axis",
    colour = "Genotype"
  )

p_binned

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "ROI_binned_AP_axis_mean_SE.pdf"),
  plot = p_binned,
  width = 10,
  height = 4,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "ROI_binned_AP_axis_mean_SE.png"),
  plot = p_binned,
  width = 10,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 600
```

# 9. Descriptive LOESS visualization

The curves below are descriptive LOESS smooths intended to show the potentially
non-linear pattern of the observations. They are not predictions from the
linear mixed-effects model and are not used for statistical inference. All
reported tests, effect estimates, and genotype-specific AP-axis slopes remain
based on the mixed-effects model in Sections 3--5.

The shaded bands are the pointwise 95% confidence bands returned by the LOESS
smoother. Because this descriptive smoother does not model the clustering of
ROIs within fish, inferential conclusions should not be drawn from the LOESS
bands.

```{r loess-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
p_loess <- ggplot(
  resq_df,
  aes(
    x = AP_axis,
    y = Area,
    colour = genotype,
    fill = genotype
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.35,
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    formula = y ~ x,
    span = loess_span,
    se = TRUE,
    level = 0.95,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = genotype_cols,
    labels = genotype_labels
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = genotype_cols,
    labels = genotype_labels
  ) +
  scamp_theme +
  labs(
    x = "AP-axis position",
    y = "Fused region area",
    title = "Fused region size along the AP axis",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Descriptive LOESS curves (span = ", loess_span,
      "); inference is based on the linear mixed-effects model"
    ),
    colour = "Genotype",
    fill = "Genotype"
  )

p_loess

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "ROI_LOESS_AP_axis_area.pdf"),
  plot = p_loess,
  width = 10,
  height = 4,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_dir, "ROI_LOESS_AP_axis_area.png"),
  plot = p_loess,
  width = 10,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 600
)
```
